Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 4.1: Electrical Energy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Electrical Energy
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

1. explain Electrical Energy

3. practise a safe skill for Electrical Energy

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Electrical Energy.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Electrical Energy.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Electrical Energy.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

1. List 8 facts on Electrical Energy.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Electrical Energy with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
